response: The code implements a Bloom filter: it stores a bit array of length `size` and, for each item, computes `num_hashes` independent hash values (by hashing the item concatenated with an index) to set or check bits. Adding an item sets all those bits to `True`; testing membership returns `True` only if every corresponding bit is set, giving a probabilistic set‑membership test with possible false positives but no false negatives.
